items.title: Supermarket refrigeration cyberattacks expose property and cyber cover gaps
items.summary: A second wave of cyberattacks targeting supermarket refrigeration across Europe highlights potential gaps between cyber and property insurance policies.

items.title: AXA Commercial appoints Carolyn Rich and launches partner leadership scheme
items.summary: AXA Commercial has hired Carolyn Rich as marketing and broker development director while its delegated authority business runs an emerging leaders programme.

items.title: MGAA opens membership to international managing general agents
items.summary: The MGAA has opened its membership to eligible managing general agents, insurers and suppliers based outside the UK and Ireland.

items.title: Aon estimates hundreds of millions in losses from European Windstorms Austen and Boelo
items.summary: Successive storms in late October 2026 caused widespread disruption and property damage across the UK, Ireland and France, with Aon projecting substantial insured losses.
